study_b.finding: no strong evidence either way in this sample (group's effect on FAA is not significant at corrected p<0.05, controlling for frontal quality) -- treat this as inconclusive, not as support for either an artifact or a real-signal reading of FAA. A robustness check using unweighted (raw) FAA in place of NeuroQA's own quality-weighted FAA reaches the same conclusion (raw-FAA group p=0.943, uncorrected).
